rows.commentary: 3.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drops it back of a length outside off, drawing the movement away as Innocent Kaia offers no stroke.
3.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi pitches it up around middle and leg, sharply tailing back in to trap Innocent Kaia on the pads, though the movement takes it harmlessly down the leg-side.
3.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drifts one onto the pads, allowing Innocent Kaia to clip it neatly into the leg-side.
3.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi sprays this one down the leg-side, and Innocent Kaia simply lets it breeze through to the keeper.
4.1: Saleem Safi digs it in short around leg, forcing Ben Curran to duck underneath the bumper.
4.2: Saleem Safi attacks a good length outside off, and Ben Curran pats it softly into the off-side to pinch a single.
4.3: Saleem Safi pushes it up around off, driven cleanly past the mid-off fielder by Innocent Kaia for a couple of runs.
4.4: Saleem Safi bangs it in short around middle and leg, and Innocent Kaia executes a rollicking swivel-pull through backward square leg for four.
4.5: Saleem Safi drifts slightly fuller around off, neatly defended into the off-side by Innocent Kaia.
4.6: Saleem Safi attacks the stumps on a length, met by a tall, defensive stance from Innocent Kaia.
5.1: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi lands it on a good length outside off, watching it shape away as Ben Curran lets it pass.
5.2: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi hits a back of a length outside off once more, finding the away-swing as Ben Curran watches it leave.
5.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi slips this one straying down the leg-side, leaving Ben Curran entirely uninterested in the chase.
5.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi probes back of a length on middle and leg, safely tucked by Ben Curran through backward square leg for a single.
5.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi angles one away outside off, and Innocent Kaia wisely offers no stroke at all.
5.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi pitches slightly fuller around middle and leg, allowing Innocent Kaia to nudge a single through square leg.
6.1: Saleem Safi tests Innocent Kaia with a fierce bouncer that draws a hurried top-edge, only for Ziaur Rahman to spill the chance sprinting to his right in the deep fine leg.
6.2: Saleem Safi digs another short delivery in, and Ben Curran swivels to send a top-edge racing away to the fine leg fence.
6.3: Saleem Safi targets a fraction wide of off-stump from back of a length, with Ben Curran leaving it alone to sail through.
6.4: Saleem Safi lands it on a length outside off and moves it away, inviting Ben Curran to watch it pass harmlessly.
19.5: Zia-ur-Rehman serves up a full ball on off, which Brendan Taylor drives crisply wide of mid-off to scamper through for a sharp single.
19.6: Zia-ur-Rehman drops a low full toss just outside off, and Ben Curran can only toe-end his drive straight to mid-off.
20.1: Qais Ahmad attacks the stumps with an overpitched delivery, forcing Brendan Taylor to jam his bat down and block safely from the crease.
20.2: Qais Ahmad floats a loopy ball on off, prompting Brendan Taylor to stride across and dead-bat it into the off-side.
20.3: Qais Ahmad fires a full one down the leg side, beating Brendan Taylor's flick to ricochet off the pads for a leg bye wide of square leg.
20.4: Qais Ahmad drops it short on off, allowing Ben Curran to punch it sharply to the right of cover for a brisk single.
20.5: Qais Ahmad attacks the stumps on a full length, and Brendan Taylor leans forward to block it solidly back.
20.6: Qais Ahmad tosses one up wide of off, and Brendan Taylor thumps a powerful drive to the left of long-off to collect a single.
21.1: Zia-ur-Rehman loops a full delivery into middle from around the wicket, easily blocked straight back to the bowler by Brendan Taylor.
21.2: Zia-ur-Rehman drops it full, and Brendan Taylor steps out to drive straight into the hands of mid-on.
21.3: Zia-ur-Rehman slides one into off stump, meeting Taylor's forward stride for a defensive block.
21.4: Zia-ur-Rehman serves up a full delivery on off, punched cleanly by Taylor to the left of mid-off for a single.

21.6: Zia-ur-Rehman pitches full just outside off, toe-ended by Curran to the right of mid-on to collect a run.
22.1: Qais Ahmad fires a short delivery outside off, sharply cut away toward the right of deep backward point for a couple of runs.

22.3: Qais Ahmad floats a flighted delivery onto off, pushed firmly by Curran to the right of mid-on.

25.5: Zia-ur-Rehman serves it full outside off, and Ben Curran can only toe-end his drive straight to mid-off.

27.1: Zia-ur-Rehman tosses one up just outside off, and Curran stretches forward to smother it firmly down the pitch.

28.1: Saleem Safi delivers on a length around middle and leg, allowing Brendan Taylor to clip it away through the leg-side for a comfortable single.

84.6: Hashmatullah Shahidi tosses it up on the off-stump line, and Brian Bennett meets it with a rock-solid defensive prod.
